# M0-S5 M4/M3: config failures close cgo, and `logos env` reports only
# user changes.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Default CC: a host compiler setting must not drive the build.
env CC=

# M4: a syntactically broken logos.toml fails closed. The build reports the
# config error, and `logos env CGO_ENABLED` prints 0, never the upstream
# default.
cd broken
env CGO_ENABLED=
[cgo] ! logos build .
[cgo] stderr 'logos\.toml:'
[cgo] logos env CGO_ENABLED
[cgo] stdout '^0$'
cd ..

# M3: without a cgo key and without CGO_ENABLED, the loGo/s forbid default
# is not a user change, so `logos env -changed` stays silent about
# CGO_ENABLED; an explicit CGO_ENABLED=1 is a change and is listed.
cd nokey
env CGO_ENABLED=
[cgo] logos env -changed
[cgo] ! stdout 'CGO_ENABLED'
env CGO_ENABLED=1
logos env -changed
stdout 'CGO_ENABLED'
cd ..

-- broken/go.mod --
module example.com/broken

go 1.27

-- broken/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "allow

-- broken/main.lgo --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("broken:", C.answer()) }

-- nokey/go.mod --
module example.com/nokey

go 1.27

-- nokey/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("nokey") }
